name: ui-hold-fill-button
title: Hold to Confirm
description: Giữ nút, màu nhấn tô dần từ trái sang; thả sớm thì màu rút về và báo đã huỷ, giữ đủ 1.2 s thì nút thành ĐÃ XÁC NHẬN có dấu tích.

moworks.author: moworks

options.cancel: s the fill runs back after an early release (0.25, power2.out)
options.label: the label
options.hint: a line shown after an early release
options.bar: a thin bar that mirrors the fill
options.cursor: an optional cursor that makes the clicks
options.approach: [x, y] px the cursor comes from
options.lead: s it arrives before a click

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Outlined button 150x46 r14. While held, the accent fill wipes left to right linearly over 1.2 s (dark label copy inside). Early release at 50 % (hold 0.4-1.0 s): the fill returns to 0 in 250 ms power2.out with a 'released → cancelled' hint (1.0-1.7 s). Second hold from 1.6 s completes at 2.8 s: 'CONFIRMED' with a check popping (back.out 0.22 s). A thin 100x4 bar below mirrors the fill. Fade back 3.55-3.8 s. Params: hold (1.2 s, none) · cancel (0.25 s, power2.out) · presses [[giây bắt đầu, giây thả]] · label.
